method: Four fresh live vendor instruction loads; local deterministic unit trial and original guide review. No vendor inference endpoint used.

lines.reason: Specify the measurement standard, for example us cup, metric cup, us fl oz or imperial fl oz

localization.rounding: Nearest 0.000001 target unit, half up; original quantities retained.
localization.review: Review measured ingredient-specific factors and culinary practicality before replacing a recipe. No density, packing method, pack size or cup standard is inferred.

findings: The sampled vendor costing instructions specify a 28 percent target and use GBP examples. This is a sample observation, not a claim about all editions.
Toolkit prompts request the operators own targets and preserve unresolved settings.
Explicit US/imperial conversions return different measured volumes; ambiguous flour cups remain blocked.
limits: Instruction loading is not an AI response or a vendor calculation.
No claim of output equivalence, superiority, production reliability, clinical suitability or measured ROI.
The 547 designed host scenarios remain NOT_RUN; these bounded checks do not execute that bank.
